# Dr. Roy Casimir

First mentioned: **3312-01-28**  
Last mentioned: **3312-04-07**

## Related


## Biography

Dr. Roy Casimir is the chief researcher at the Holloway Bioscience Institute and a leading voice in exobiological study. He first came to galactic attention in early 3305 when he announced plans to construct a dedicated xenological research centre in the Nahuaru system, requesting materials and exploration data from independent pilots.

Casimir's most prominent work began in 3312 with his study of Radicoida unica, the unique exobiological flora discovered in the HIP 87621 system. Based on data provided by the October Consortium — which controlled access to the system — he described the plant's genetic composition as "mercurial" and noted its remarkable cellular resilience. He has continued to collaborate with the October Consortium on unlocking the plant's secrets, echoing Ram Tah's findings that the Guardians likely cultivated the species for its medicinal properties and expressing hope that further research will reveal practical medical applications.
